structure: Overview: a busy coffee shop; read the name and one or two prices from the menu board.
The counter: barista, cashier, the customer paying, and the people waiting in line.
The pick-up shelf and the seating area (the two seniors, the woman with the laptop).
Right side: the spill and the employee mopping; finish with the dog outside and the overall mood.
modelAnswer: This picture shows a busy coffee shop called Driftwood Coffee Co., where a latte costs five twenty-five. Behind the counter, a barista on the right is steaming milk at the espresso machine, and a cashier with red hair is ringing up an order. A woman in an orange top is tapping her card on the payment machine, while a man in a dark suit and a young guy holding a red skateboard wait their turn behind her. Next to them, a courier with a green backpack is reaching up to grab a bag from the mobile pick-up shelf. In the front left, two seniors are chatting over their drinks and a pastry, and beside them, a young woman is working on her laptop. On the right, someone has knocked over a cup, so there's coffee on the floor. An employee is mopping it up, and a yellow warning sign has been put out. Through the window on the left, you can see a dog tied to a bench outside. It looks like the morning rush is in full swing.

usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'ring up' = tính tiền trên máy — cụm động từ đặc trưng của ngành dịch vụ.
Cụm cố định 'wait one's turn' = chờ đến lượt.

usefulExpressions.expression: …are chatting over their drinks and a pastry
usefulExpressions.usageVi: 'chat over + đồ ăn/uống' = vừa uống vừa trò chuyện — cách nói rất tự nhiên.

usefulExpressions.expression: …someone has knocked over a cup, so…
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Hiện tại hoàn thành + 'so' để giải thích kết quả nhìn thấy (vũng cà phê).

usefulExpressions.expression: …a yellow warning sign has been put out
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Câu bị động hiện tại hoàn thành khi không cần nói ai làm.

usefulExpressions.expression: …the morning rush is in full swing
usefulExpressions.usageVi: Thành ngữ 'in full swing' = đang lúc cao điểm, sôi động nhất.

commonMistakes: Đọc giá '$5.25' thành 'five dollar twenty-five'; nói 'five twenty-five' hoặc 'five dollars and twenty-five cents'.
Dùng 'clean the floor with a mop' dài dòng; 'mop it up' gọn và tự nhiên hơn.
Quên những chi tiết nhỏ ở rìa tranh (con chó ngoài cửa sổ, kệ lấy đồ); nhắc tới chúng giúp đạt mức 8+.

Fixes: customer paying is drawn in an orange top with a dark skirt -> "orange top"; the seniors' cups are not identifiable as tea -> "their drinks" (answer + expression); "Through the window" -> "Through the window on the left".
